reason: H0 only instantiates wuffs_webp__decoder and drives the generic image-decoder sequence. It does not directly exercise the changed public VP8 quirk API, including arbitrary QUIRK_SOURCE_LENGTH values, the new QUIRK_WIDTH_AND_HEIGHT value encoding, quirk reset, getter behavior, or sequencing quirks before decode_image_config. WebP internally supplies constrained quirk values, so several validation and state transitions remain unreachable.
evidence: H0 initializes only wuffs_webp__decoder and upcasts it through wuffs_webp__decoder__upcast_as__wuffs_base__image_decoder.
S1 adds vp8.QUIRK_WIDTH_AND_HEIGHT handling to decoder.set_quirk! and decoder.get_quirk.
decoder.set_quirk! now validates odd/even, zero, minimum, and maximum QUIRK_SOURCE_LENGTH encodings and resets partitioned_data_length when value is zero.
The WebP path constructs QUIRK_SOURCE_LENGTH as ((chunk_length as base.u64) << 1) | 1 and constructs QUIRK_WIDTH_AND_HEIGHT from already-validated VP8X dimensions, excluding arbitrary API inputs.
QUIRK_WIDTH_AND_HEIGHT mutates width, height, and calculate_mbw_mbh-derived work-buffer fields before decode_image_config, creating a stateful protocol not explicitly driven by fuzz_image_decoder.
recommended_action: Add a VP8-focused harness that fuzzes set_quirk/get_quirk keys and 64-bit values, including source-length reset and boundary encodings, width/height valid and invalid encodings, repeated or reordered calls, and subsequent decode_image_config/decode_frame operations.
